announcements.title: Rift Launcher 2.4.6 ist da!
announcements.message:
Fix: admins can close or remove countdowns.
Fix: NeoForge launch (libraryDirectory), still needs a test.
New: beta update channel with a “Full release” button.
New: all pets in 3D, 3D previews for capes, skins and emotes, cape PNG upload.
New: hidden Intro animation (Reimagined Intro), under Settings → Beta, off by default.
New in-game widgets: Weather & time of day, Statistics (play time and deaths), Radar (markers and players).
New in-game key H: sends your coordinates to chat.
Cloud: the Mojang token check is cached.
